parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   If this is your first query or no next queries are to be sent, ignore this parameter.
*   You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of **NextToken**.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **ANYCASTEIPADDRESS**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eipanycast list-tag-resources --resource-id aeip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000 --resource-type ANYCASTEIPADDRESS --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 50 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eipanycast ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'aeip-2zeerraiwb7ujsxdc0000' --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --MaxResults 50 --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --ResourceType ANYCASTEIPADDRESS
